steps.content: [Small CG][Leaf rustling noise][Transition to communication]

At the edge of Désir, a woman stands, her gaze fixed on DisCity. Beside her, a patch of freshly planted datura flowers sways gently. In her hand, she holds a confidential audio recording from DisCity.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: A Mania anomaly of this magnitude... Why it takes until now to address it?

steps.speaker: Outland Affairs Bureau
steps.content: Désir is a special case. It sits right at DisCity's border but beyond our jurisdiction, complicating any direct intervention. And... the situation there has something to do with DisCity's immigration issues.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I thought DisCity is always open to immigrants? Otherwise, places like the Drifter Camp wouldn't even exist.

steps.speaker: Outland Affairs Bureau
steps.content: It was. But after the disasters worsened in N.F. 106, the surge in refugees became unmanageable. They've since had to tighten entry criteria several times. Now, those with criminal records, forged documents, or unclear identities are all denied access.

steps.speaker: Outland Affairs Bureau
steps.content: But criminals always find a sneaky way in. Though immigration policies may have toughened, the WhiteSands trade routes remain active. After all, smuggling people is far more lucrative than smuggling goods.

steps.speaker: Outland Affairs Bureau
steps.content: The prime suspect behind this Mania anomaly, Vautour Bleu, is not only the leader of Désir but also a noted merchant operating in WhiteSands.

Hearing her own name in the recording, the woman simply smiles. She bends down to sprinkle a final handful of white sand over a nameplate engraved with Velvet Valley words, quietly concealing the loss of a young life.

steps.speaker: Outland Affairs Bureau
steps.content: Désir used to be a holiday resort for DisCity. But as sandstorms encroached on this place, the town was buried in white sand and removed from the border. That's when Vautour Bleu seized control of the ruins. Using dubious financial tactics, she gathered a group of penniless, undocumented immigrants dreaming of instant success in DisCity, and established her dominion over Désir.

steps.speaker: Outland Affairs Bureau
steps.content: We've made several attempts to investigate, but her extensive connections in Syndicate have protected her—even won respect from local gangs. And she always got tipped off before we could act. Her caravan's paperwork is spotless too. A vantage point in WhiteSands, though we can't even find a single trace of incriminating evidence.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So, if I'm not mistaken, you're dumping your problem on us? I took a leave to handle the dark web in Eastside, and now that I'm back, you're telling me the MBCC is running errands for the Outland Affairs Bureau?

steps.speaker: Outland Affairs Bureau
steps.content: A powerful Sinner is dashing around the border, and her Outland forces may have already infiltrated DisCity... Even if you're not concerned, the 9th Agency surely won't just sit back and watch, right Chief?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So, Vautour Bleu is a Sinner, but you kept this information only to leverage it now—using Mania and the 9th Agency to force me to solve your problem. Am I right, Guillotin?

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: For DisCity's sake, any threat in WhiteSands must be snuffed out before it hits us.

The recording cuts off right after this grandiose declaration. As the wind of WhiteSands carries the news, Vautour Bleu contemplates whether it heralds a crisis or an opportunity for the oasis behind her. Her caravan subordinates stands nearby, awaiting her next command.

Without a word, Vautour Bleu places the bouquet of white flowers and the recording tape atop the sand pit, then lights a fire. The flames quickly consume the evidence, turning it into curling ashes that swirl away in the wind.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Allons-y. The flowers are wilting faster now. Time is running out for Désir.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: While I'm away, if any new guests arrive, make sure the townsfolk give them a proper bienvenue.
[Bustling chatter][Town center]
Désir's central square buzzes with life. The enticing aroma of freshly baked bread wafts from a nearby bakery, filling the air with warmth.

steps.speaker: Primrose
steps.content: I wonder what Sheila is doing right now?

steps.speaker: Liam
steps.content: Probably just waking up in some ultra-plush bed, then getting a full check-up from one of DisCity's best doctors!

steps.speaker: Primrose
steps.content: Yeah, that must be it. I bet after that, she'll write to each of us, just like she does to her family. You know, to let us know she's doing okay.

steps.speaker: Primrose
steps.content: Miss Vautour Bleu's caravan left for DisCity in the middle of the night. They didn't even have time to say goodbye to everyone. I bet Sheila's feeling pretty guilty right now, probably writing pages of apologies!
Primrose said as she skillfully stacked the last loaf and tried to lift the bread basket, now piled high like a small mountain.

steps.speaker: Primrose
steps.content: Quick, Liam, give me a hand! I can't see anything but the bread!
Before she can finish the sentence, a pair of steady hands grasps the other end of the basket, helping to bear the load.
The grip is too firm to be Liam's. Primrose is just about to say thanks, but as she peeks around the mountain of bread, she finds herself face-to-face with a complete stranger.
Miss, am I in Désir?
